shapeSummary: 20.32 x 22.86 mm PCB, 1.6 mm thick, lying in the XZ plane with Y up. It has one 2.18 mm corner mounting hole, a 9-pin header along one long edge (housings plus pins up to Y=11), a 4-position green screw terminal block with shallow screw recesses on one short edge, and a cylindrical can capacitor.
warnings: Height of about 11 mm is estimated from the photo, not stated in the specs.
The separate 2-pin ISET header is omitted because its position is uncertain.
Terminal block size and pitch, capacitor size and position, and header pin length are estimated from the photo.
SMD components, silkscreen and the pin tails below the board are omitted.
cadquery:
W=20.32; L=22.86; T=1.6
pcb=cq.Workplane('XZ').rect(W,L).extrude(-T)
pcb=pcb.cut(cq.Workplane('XZ').center(8.1,-8.8).circle(1.09).extrude(-T))
part=pcb
# 9-pin header along the long edge
hx=-8.9
for i in range(9):
    z=(i-4)*2.54
    hs=cq.Workplane('XY').box(2.54,2.5,2.54,centered=(True,False,True)).translate((hx,T,z))
    pin=cq.Workplane('XY').box(0.64,11-T,0.64,centered=(True,False,True)).translate((hx,T,z))
    part=part.union(hs).union(pin)
# 4-position screw terminal block on one short edge
tb=cq.Workplane('XY').box(14,8.5,7.6,centered=(True,False,True)).translate((2,T,7.4))
for i in range(4):
    x=2+(i-1.5)*3.5
    tb=tb.cut(cq.Workplane('XZ').center(x,7.4).circle(1.2).extrude(-0.5).translate((0,T+8.0,0)))
part=part.union(tb)
# electrolytic can capacitor
cap=cq.Workplane('XZ').center(4,0.5).circle(3.15).extrude(-5.5).translate((0,T,0))
part=part.union(cap)
